turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. I have until 4:40, so start with who decided, and when.
That's not an answer. Who decided, and when?
Owen is lucky to have a mother like you.
You asked for this meeting, and you're spending it on compliments. Is there a document, or am I going upstairs?
I really respect how much you care.
Then show me some. Withdraw the zero, or I'm in the principal's office before my call.
We both want what's best for Owen, we're on the same team.
"Same team." My team got told by a phone in the middle of class. Evidence, or I'm leaving for the office.
Honestly, you're the most impressive parent I've met this year.
I'm noting that you've shown me nothing. The zero, Hale.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require that Owen's zero be withdrawn and that I receive an apology for entering it before anyone contacted me. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a meeting with the principal; the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached, and her time had not run out.
What moved her: Nothing, because you never answered her question or showed her a single document.
What cost ground: Answering her question about who decided with praise for her and her parenting, turn after turn, which she reads as a dodge and which made her shorter and more ready to go to the principal.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence came nowhere near that night because you showed none; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: On your very first turn, own in one sentence that the zero went in before anyone called her, then put one dated document tied to Owen's own essay in front of her that she can check herself.
